summary.text: Mike Cierpiot, a Republican, represents Missouri Senate District 8, covering eastern Jackson County; he was elected in a November 2017 special election.
He chairs the Senate Commerce, Consumer Protection, Energy and the Environment Committee.

paragraphs.text: Cierpiot was born in Kansas City, graduated from De La Salle High School, and attended Longview Community College and the University of Missouri-Kansas City.
He worked at AT&T for 38 years as a network engineer and lives in Lee's Summit.
Before the Senate he served seven years in the Missouri House, three as assistant majority floor leader and later as majority floor leader.
He received the 2013 Spirit of Commerce Award from the Missouri Chamber of Commerce.
He is married to Connie Cierpiot, who also served as a state representative; they have two children and two grandchildren.
